column2: Ugh...!
To survive in a world of endless battle, the Demon race acquired a special ability!
A special ability?
The ability to merge.\n\nThe ability to fuse with other living things and take in their traits.
Th-they're devils!
That's right, devils!\n\nMerging again and again to grow stronger, the Demons transformed into monsters with grotesque shapes and powers!
I can't believe devils really existed...
Akira-kun...
So they've come at last, the Demons! You two, this way!
The Demons sealed in Ice Age ice have revived! They mean to take the Earth back from mankind!
We're running! Battle is what the Demons live for! Killing living things is a Demon's joy!
We have to call for help!
You think humans would believe Demons exist? They'd just think we'd gone mad!
There's one room that can keep them out! Demons of that level probably can't get in!
Ah!
Ryo! It's a dead end!
Damn! I ran the wrong way down the hall!
...That was a lie.
Here, they won't get in so easily.
But why is there a room like this...?
In the Demon history I saw, they kept merging over and over. If we escape in here, we can block their merging attacks, right?
I see!
...Wrong. It's for fighting the Demons.
The way to fight the Demons... is...
A Demon!?
Did it teleport in!?
Akira!
Akira-kun!
WHOAAAAAAAA!
The way to fight the Demons... is! To become a Demon yourself!
What!?
...I've got it! I've got a devil's body! I'm... I'm Devilman!
Amon, proud warrior of the Demons, the brave one... So a human has taken over your mind...
Call it a hijacking!\n\nI've hijacked a Demon's body and its powers! To wipe out you Demons!
{p}! Fight with us!
What!?
If you don't fight, you'll just get caught up in it and die!
G-got it...!
...I meant for Akira and me both to become Devilman together. {p}, I never meant to drag you into this.
Why Akira-kun?
If someone with an evil heart merges with a Demon, he becomes a Demon through and through in an instant.
You trusted Akira-kun.
Even while he lost his reason to fear and acted on instinct, Akira kept his human heart.
...Wh-what about me?
You've come around, Akira!
How do you feel?
Feel? Heh heh, I feel great! Who knew fighting felt this good!
He merged with a Demon, but the Akira who was so gentle and timid...
{p}! Ryo! Let's get out of here! I'll wipe out every Demon in this house, one after another!
Akira-kun...
It's locked. It won't open.
We somehow made it out!
It's too early to relax! We have to get away from here, fast!
Stop, Ryo!
What is it, Akira...\n\n...!?
That's...!?
A black moon...!?
Fear drives mankind mad...
...Has it stopped?
A black moon and an earthquake... Is this the Demons' doing too?
Looks like we're in the same place as before the quake. Thank goodness...
What do you mean?
Actually...
...!? Perhaps it's the Demons' declaration of war. But even so, it's baffling...
...Miki-chan!
Miki-chan?
Miki-chan of the Makimura family, where Akira-kun boards?
That was a big earthquake... I'm worried about Miki-chan...
Come to think of it, I hope {s} is okay too...
Let's go down the mountain.\n\nWe'll find {s} and then head for the Makimura house.
At this rate, we can't get back to the Hill of Beginnings...
We'll have to trust she's safe and head for the Makimura house.
Once we're down the mountain, we'll find another way for sure, {p}!
Yeah, you're right...
It looks like a ruin... Strange. Was there a village like this?
Didn't the Demons attack it?
It looks like it was wrecked a lot longer ago.
We'll need to look into this...
The Kanto Hellquake! And it happened years ago!? Can the Demons control time too?
If the Demons could do that,\n\nthey'd have taken the Earth back long ago.
You guys better hide!
Who are you?
I'm Ryu Takuma! And you?
I'm {p}.
Hey! What's about to start?
The Dragons are chasing that man, and they're near the village.
That man? The Dragons?
Look over by the entrance!
We're in trouble! The Dragons are coming!
That giant man is...!?
Muscles of a gorilla! Fangs of a wolf! Burning eyes, the fire of the primeval! Seven foot two, every inch of him packed with fighting energy. His name is Violence Jack!
Violence Jack...
He's the giant they call "the Monster of Kanto."
GRAAAAAAAH!!
He's gonna fight the Dragons! Let's go see!
Ever since the Japanese government abandoned Kanto, nothing but outlaws gather here...
It's like a band of mounted warriors from the Warring States era!
The Slum King, ruler of lawless Kanto! And the army he put together! That's them, the Dragons!
